evidence: project_notification -> project_refresh(force=true, own work) -> ticket_for; existing.forced=true returns existing_ticket before submit_with_work
impact_or_question: Concurrent second distinct manifest refresh/remove is dropped while a forced ticket is in flight.
next_action: Separate reuse of identical refresh request from admission of distinct notification work; add deterministic two-path overlap regression.

evidence: canonical_notification_path -> join_under_root performs lexical component mapping only; collect_incremental_manifest_batch -> append_candidate_from_manifest_path -> read_bounded_utf8_file -> File::open follows symlink; full traversal file_type.is_symlink refuses link
impact_or_question: An accepted root-relative notification can read a root-external manifest through a symlink and publish it, unlike full-scan discovery. DLL execution still requires the downstream artifact authority.
next_action: Define refresh physical-path containment and link policy while retaining lexical handling for already-deleted paths; add root-relative linked manifest case.

evidence: MeteredDiscoveryVisitor::manifest converts recoverable bad manifest to diagnostic; from_incremental_payload copies every base.collector_diagnostics and extends without path invalidation

evidence: authority::input_identity formats root/work kind/directories/entries only; public snapshot exposes input_identity and derives Eq for identity
impact_or_question: Do consumers need a content/version identity? Equal-size content changes can have the same descriptor; current repository consumers only assert propagation.

evidence: root_identity evicts lexically first identity at 32; generation uses cached_root_identity? only; refresh snapshot state retains up to 16 root/input keys; resolve_root calls also grow alias cache
impact_or_question: A published root can lose its path-to-key mapping and generation(path) returns None while a prepared root handle can still query its snapshot. Existing tests intentionally require cached query, so eviction semantics need an explicit decision.
next_action: Decide whether live publication aliases must be pinned or cache-miss None is acceptable; add 32+ aliases test without filesystem query.

evidence: NativePluginDiscoverySnapshot::from_index extends collector diagnostics with manifest_index.project duplicate diagnostics; reserve_diagnostic validates only sink admissions; no final budget validation
impact_or_question: A valid candidate set under max_candidates with more duplicate package paths than max_diagnostics publishes more diagnostics than the declared ceiling.
next_action: Account for derived duplicate diagnostics before snapshot publication; test max_diagnostics+1 duplicate paths below candidate limit.

evidence: collect_root_scan keeps already-admitted candidates when traversal returns a typed filesystem error, emits diagnostic then returns Ok identity; service therefore publishes payload

next_action: Compare selection/export consumers and define full-scan partial success versus failed publication; add later-directory error case.

evidence: from_incremental_payload clones baseline index then from_index project clones selected candidates and diagnostics outside NativePluginDiscoveryRefreshSink
impact_or_question: Specify whether max_scratch_bytes applies to collector scratch only or also index publication clones; current tests only exercise pre-materialization sink accounting.
next_action: Calculate publication allocations for large retained snapshot; either document separate bound or admit combined publication scratch.

evidence: Test waits DeadlineExceeded with sole worker blocked then releases worker; service::collect_generation calls request.check_active()? before shared.collector.collect; expired request returns without BlockingCollector::collect sending
impact_or_question: The test requires a late collector-start message that the current early active-check contract prevents, so the receive times out.
next_action: Observe worker retirement or last_failure instead of a collector-start signal; preserve expiry-before-collection contract in regression.
